scope: F01–F02 per-document plain-text notebooks and named passage references; synthetic documents, isolated SQLite data
native_display: Private Xvfb / X11 with Cairo software rendering; G_DEBUG=fatal-criticals

accessibility.scope: AT-SPI tree inspection only; not an Orca usability session

volume_checks.claim: Functional round trips and native editing/navigation only; no performance percentile or memory bound claimed

visual_review: Wide side panel with reachable reference controls
Short window enforces 650 px minimum while stacked
reproduced_and_fixed: Panel failed to return beside the reader after widening
Hidden navigation sidebar consumed spare width
GTK collapsed notebook selection when unmapping
Raw scroll offsets clamped against incomplete GTK text layout
Small stacked windows left no readable document viewport
Retained draft matching could follow a reused old file path after Locate
A notebook reset during animated scrolling made GTK finalize the animation twice during unmap
Walking wrapped lines made scroll-position capture quadratic for long paragraphs
Native hit-testing over blank space missed right-to-left wrapped text

storage.migration: Additive transaction; rollback and preexisting document/bookmark preservation tested
storage.failed_drafts: Retained on the existing worker, with visible Retry and close protection
storage.unreadable_notebooks: Editing disabled; never replaced with empty text

limits: No new manual Orca usability session
No new Wayland/display-scaling or full PRD performance qualification; notebook operation and idle observations are recorded
Active notebook loads in full; undo history is limited to 100 actions and is not durable across document switches
Export, highlights, quotation capture, and inline references remain outside F01–F02
commands: scripts/native-smoke.py: Markdown --edit, EPUB --stress, PDF, --storage-failure, and --notebook-only with second-process restart for all three formats

followup_review.scope: Debug-build notebook flows and process restarts; focused review of persistence, lifecycle and editing context
regressions_observed_before_fix: PDF handle-link callback panicked on a null origin; reproduced with an explicit missing-origin native signal
fixes: Save the top display-line character within a soft-wrapped paragraph, instead of its logical paragraph start
Retain explicit notebook visibility intent while loading and persist it after successful load
Receive Papers handle-link notifications without decoding unused arguments through a non-null generated binding
commands: G_DEBUG=fatal-criticals with gdb --batch; SIGUSR1 and SIGUSR2 passed through for WebKit; isolated EPUB notebook flow (two completed runs)
observations_resolved_in_final_audit: One concurrent EPUB run emitted g_signal_handler_disconnect and gdk_frame_clock_idle_end_updating criticals. The normal rerun and two complete GDB runs with G_DEBUG=fatal-criticals exited normally without reproducing them. Cause remains unresolved; later passing runs are not evidence of a fix.

final_audit.scope: DRY and performance review; strict native regressions with G_DEBUG=fatal-criticals

gtk_warning.cause: Clearing a text buffer during scroll animation caused reentrant adjustment updates while GTK detached the frame clock; the animation was finalized twice
gtk_warning.fix: Stop scroll adjustments before hiding, then clear the unmapped notebook buffer

cleanups: Share document-identity matching for retained notebook lookup and replacement
Share notebook size bounds and defaults between validation and native layout
Capture editing context independently of text; only extract text when it changes
Use GTK hit-testing and a binary search over blank space, without scanning preceding wrapped lines
Reuse the native qualification runner for notebook operation and idle probes
Keep notebook pane fields scoped to the shell

performance.scope: Optimized build; isolated X11/Cairo display; synthetic text; same machine; no other regression runs during final measurement
performance.baseline_limitation: The original probe was stopped at 75 seconds; the 278400-byte paragraph case had not completed, so baseline anchor arrays are partial
limitations: Direct native API measurements, not physical typing or frame-time percentiles
Save is measured immediately after editing, including synchronous GTK layout; ordinary autosave is debounced
278400 bytes in a single paragraph still incur roughly 100 ms of native edit/layout work; multiline 1.08 MB notes are substantially cheaper
Active notebook and undo history remain memory-resident; no arbitrary-size latency or memory guarantee

idle.instrumentation: optimized native app with opt-in probe; not frame-time or input-latency qualification

idle.activity_before_idle: 40 turns and 20 mode changes with notebook editing

commands: G_DEBUG=fatal-criticals python3 scripts/native-smoke.py: Markdown --edit, EPUB --stress, PDF, storage failure, and notebook-only restarts for each format

encrypted_pdf.test_fixture_dependency: pypdf 6.1.3 installed only in a temporary test directory; no production dependency added
